parent_objective: run fresh-seed source-diverse protected PPO smoke repeat from M328 base

public_gates: exact M297 and exact M270 no-regression versus M328 after repair
M183/M170 first replay gate versus M328
M267/M264 first replay gate versus M328
forbidden_shortcuts: do not skip source-diverse protected gates
do not tune from private holdouts
hypothesis: A fresh PPO seed from the M328 source-diverse public base can repeat the M327 pattern: exact repair, source-diverse protected proof, old-key singleton-window audit, and first replay gates all pass before any longer PPO.
success_criteria: raw PPO completes and writes checkpoint
repaired candidate does not regress exact M297 or exact M270 versus M328
old 9944 diagnostic is reported and classified
M183/M170 and M267/M264 first replay gates pass
failure_criteria: exact repair fails or exact objectives regress
